name: app.aplusz.fixmypc/fix-my-pc
title: Fix My PC
description: Which one-press fix solves this computer problem, and where is it?

tools.name: find_fix
tools.description: Which one-press fix solves this computer problem? Give the problem in the user's own words (for example: my wifi keeps dropping, pc is slow, no sound). problem is required. system is optional (windows, macos, linux, android, ios): pass it when the user said which device they use, and the answer adds what the fix does on that system. Returns up to 3 fixes, best first, each with the page to open; there the user presses Fix it. Do not invent a fix name: call this.

problem.description: The problem in plain words. Example: bluetooth keeps disconnecting

tools.name: list_fixes
tools.description: Which computer problems can Fix My PC take care of? Lists every fix with the question it answers and its page. category is optional: one of speed, internet, devices, windows, startup, files, security, customize.
